_doc: Clip theo lỗi L1 của người học ngôn ngữ này (docs/specs/social-l1-clips.md). Giáo viên nói tiếng Anh ≤B1; native.* = bản tay (tầng i18n-fixed), {m:từ[#nghĩa]} lấy nghĩa từ web/packs/<lang>.json (vi: kho từ).

mistake.en: Not changing the verb for the past (Yesterday I go)
mistake.vi: Không đổi động từ sang quá khứ: "Yesterday I go" (tiếng Indonesia không chia thì)
mistake.l1: Indonesian verbs do not change for tense; time words do the job.

hook.bad: Yesterday I go to the market
hook.good: Yesterday I went to the market

segments.text: Don't say, yesterday I go to the market. Say, yesterday I went to the market.
For the past, the English verb changes. Go becomes went.
Repeat after me. Yesterday I went to the market.
Great job! Say it again with a friend.

native.caption: Kata kerja bahasa Indonesia tidak berubah untuk masa lalu, tetapi kata kerja bahasa Inggris berubah: “Yesterday I went to the market”, bukan “Yesterday I go to the market”. Go menjadi went. Ulangi bersama Ama dan latihan tata bahasa di aplikasi Lexkite.

en.caption: Indonesian verbs do not change for the past, but English verbs do: “Yesterday I went to the market”, not “Yesterday I go to the market”. Go becomes went. Repeat after Ama and practice grammar in the Lexkite app.
